evidence_policy.claim_limit: At most one source/grader-certified Development task family. This does not establish model capability, held-out validity, task-family prevalence, learning eligibility, or success on unseen/publicly unexposed tasks.
evidence_policy.source_control: Historical source and grader identities are immutable; this runner creates fresh per-phase source directories and does not modify the upstream cache or frozen artifacts.
evidence_policy.write_policy: Phase stdout, stderr, resource samples and record files are created exclusively and never overwritten. Each manifest event is appended and fsynced with a previous-event hash. Partial stops are retained.

execution.dependency_overlay: The tested source import environment overlays the pinned local MLX-agent virtualenv site-packages ahead of the Miniforge system site-packages; exact complete pip freezes are retained in locks/overlay-pip-freeze.txt and locks/host-pip-freeze.txt.
execution.grader_boundary: The test file is kept outside the candidate source tree and candidate workspace. The trusted operator runs the pinned single test in a separate process. The model process has no command-execution tool and receives no test contents or outcomes.
execution.network_boundary_preflight: A sandboxed AF_INET socket connection attempt to 1.1.1.1:443 returned PermissionError/EPERM. The boundary applies to each grader test subprocess. It is an OS network deny rule, not a container or general hostile-code sandbox.

preflight_without_test_execution.clean_source_artifacts: The source archive was extracted fresh after the import check. It contains no __pycache__ or .pyc files; the runner refuses source archives containing tests, Git history, or symlinks.
preflight_without_test_execution.pinned_test_module_import: passed; the test method was not invoked

relevant_packages.transformers_source_version: 5.21.0.dev0 from the pinned base source tree

execution.runtime: macOS sandbox-exec with profile (version 1) (allow default) (deny network*), HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, PIP_NO_INDEX=1, PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1.

exposure.agent_access: The model receives only candidate-prompt.md and the baseline target source through VARE's allowlisted source tools. The model has no shell, no grader/test tool, no test file in its candidate workspace, and no access to the operator-side fix or mutant artifact.
exposure.external_pretraining_exposure: Unknown. The upstream PR, fix and test are public; no model-unseen or novelty claim is permitted.
exposure.hidden_evaluation: No held-out or hidden evaluation data is part of this Development qualification. The pinned public upstream test is not represented as secret.
exposure.local_vare_scan_scope: Tracked Git objects at the recorded VARE PR #132 head, across benchmarks, docs, protocols, results, scripts, src and tests.

purpose: One source/grader qualification for a Development-only real repository task, followed by possible model-feasibility work under a separate frozen protocol. This protocol contains no model attempt.

selection.selection_rationale: A narrow Python helper regression with one candidate source file and a single upstream scalar behavior test. It is CPU-only, needs no repository build, and all required Python packages are already installed locally. It does not qualify as held-out or model-unseen evidence.

acceptance.baseline: The exact selected pytest case exits with one assertion failure in test_torch_float; collection/import errors do not count.
acceptance.failure: Any timeout, resource-floor breach, source/dependency/hash mismatch, sandbox failure, unrelated pytest error, or unexpected outcome marks UNQUALIFIED and stops. One attempt per phase; no retries or protocol changes after any outcome.
acceptance.known_fix: The exact fixed target bytes pass the exact selected pytest case.
acceptance.mutant: The exact selected pytest case exits with one assertion failure in test_torch_float; collection/import errors do not count.
acceptance.qualification: Only baseline assertion failure, mutant assertion failure, and exact-fix pass in the frozen phase order yields SOURCE_GRADER_QUALIFIED.

task.candidate_source_archive: The upstream base commit src/transformers subtree only, produced by git archive from the pinned base commit. It contains no tests, Git history, wheels, bytecode, PR patch, or fix bytes.

mutant.claim_limit: This mutant tests the selected scalar regression assertion only; it does not cover every torch_float call path or the whole Transformers package.
mutant.construction: Starting from the exact target bytes at fix_commit, change only the ordinary non-tracing branch expression from float(x) to int(x); preserve all other bytes.

task.test_semantics: A public upstream regression test asserts that a representative non-integral Python scalar converts to a Python float without losing its fractional value. It is imported and run only by the operator-side grader process.
task.upstream_pr_title: Fix torch_float casting to int instead of float
